title: Probably a good value
text: Probably a good value. Cheap both in price and execution but I’m keeping these because they are still a good buy if they last. The zipper is a concern but these are large and hold about 3 king blankets or 3 king pillows and a bit more.

product_metadata.title: Ziz Home Blankets Clothes Storage Bag Closet Organization | Linen Blanket Storage Sweater Storage Duvet Storage Bags Clear Transparent Window (3)
features: ANTI MOLD - Moisture-resistant material that helps keep your blankets or clothes dry and undamaged.
PERFECT SIZE - 24" x 18" x 12" inches, there is enough space for your blanket, clothes and more. Even though having a large capacity, this storage can be folded when not in use.
DURABILITY - Durable and resistant material have overcome repeated sliding tests. In addition, the secure closure and stitches ensure total security for your clothes during long periods of storage.
SAVE TIME AND SPACE - You do not need to go through piles before you find what you are looking for. Save time, just peep through the transparent PVC window, locate what you need and just pull it out.
MULTIPURPOSE - This multipurpose storage is not just made for blankets and clothes, you can also use this to store different things like toys, stuffed animals, pillows, and more.
